files.code:
-- 5c. Implement subqueries. Run 5b first.
USE fsd_lab5;

-- Scalar subquery: students whose CGPA is above the overall average.
SELECT id, name, cgpa FROM students
WHERE cgpa > (SELECT AVG(cgpa) FROM students)
ORDER BY id;

-- IN subquery: students in a branch containing a student with CGPA >= 9.
SELECT id, name, branch FROM students
WHERE branch IN (SELECT branch FROM students WHERE cgpa >= 9)
ORDER BY id;

-- Correlated subquery: students above their own branch's average.
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.branch, s.cgpa FROM students AS s
WHERE s.cgpa > (SELECT AVG(s2.cgpa) FROM students AS s2 WHERE s2.branch = s.branch)
ORDER BY s.id;

USE fsd_lab5;

-- IN subquery: students in a branch containing a student with CGPA >= 9.
SELECT id, name, branch FROM students

-- Correlated subquery: students above their own branch's average.
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.branch, s.cgpa FROM students AS s

ORDER BY s.id;
